ch25-open.title: Canvas AI
ch25-open.standfirst: What the AI actually is in Canvas M — and what it does and doesn't do on your board.

c25-canvas-ai.heading: The AI reads the meeting and writes back text
c25-canvas-ai.lead: Canvas M's on-canvas intelligence is the MCM Bot. It reads the live meeting — the chat, the transcript and the text on the canvas — and writes its answer back as a real, shared canvas element everyone can see and move.
c25-canvas-ai.body: It is a text assistant: it summarises, lists decisions, and answers questions. It does not draw shapes, arrange your layout, or generate models — so treat it as a smart note-taker on the board, not an auto-designer.
